# OCSP stapling + must-staple test vectors for TlsLib4Pascal (RFC 6960 / RFC 7633).
# EC P-256 hierarchy: root_cert (anchor) -> issuer_cert -> leaf_cert. The issuer signs
# the authoritative OCSP responses; delegate_cert is an id-kp-OCSPSigning responder the
# issuer delegated to; other_ca_cert is unrelated. muststaple_leaf_cert carries the RFC
# 7633 TLS Feature (status_request); badfeature_leaf_cert's TLS Feature value is a bare
# INTEGER (not a SEQUENCE) - malformed. ocsp_good/revoked/stale are about leaf_cert;
# ocsp_stale's window is 2019..2020 (always past); ocsp_unauthorized is signed by
# other_ca; ocsp_good_delegated by delegate_cert; ocsp_muststaple_good about the
# must-staple leaf.
